map.name: Ostra
map.trouble: Skarn the Necromancer has taken the old lighthouse on Gorm Isle and calls the drowned dead up out of Lake Vell, so the fishermen of Ostra dare not put out their boats.

guard_bark.specifics: Brannoc keeps the causeway gate out to Gorm Isle, shut by Mayor Odrick because the dead walk the causeway at night.

first.speaker: Brannoc
first.text: Sorry, stranger. Nobody crosses the causeway without Mayor Odrick's say-so. The dead walk it after dark.

again.speaker: Brannoc
again.text: I said the gate's shut. Off with you!

later.speaker: Brannoc
later.text: Mayor Odrick has given his word. The causeway is open to you. Good luck!

bounty_offer.specifics: Gubby, an old fisherman, pays to have the Giant Leeches cleared out of the reed beds south of the village.

offer.speaker: Gubby
offer.text:
Leeches! Giant Leeches! They've moved into the reed beds south of the village and they eat every fish that goes in my nets. Ate half my net too, the greedy things.

Ever since that Necromancer came to Gorm Isle, every nasty thing in Lake Vell's been crawling up on our shore.

Kill them leeches for me and I'll make it worth your while, lad.

reminder.speaker: Gubby
reminder.text: Them leeches still out there? I can't fish with 'em about!

completion.speaker: Gubby
completion.text: Ha, ha! No more leeches! I'll have a full net by sundown! Here, take this gold. You earned every piece of it.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in the reed beds south of Ostra.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Hulda, an old fishwife, lost her magic amulet to the Urchins of the caves under Black Cliff.

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text:
Thieves! Nasty little thieves! The Urchins crept down from the caves under Black Cliff last night and took my magic amulet right off my neck while I slept!

I can't go up there, not with my bad knees and the Undead about.

Would you get it back for me, kind sir? I'd be ever so grateful.

refusal.speaker: Hulda
refusal.text: Well! I never! Some hero you are.

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: Have you got my amulet yet? Those Urchins are a sneaky lot, you know.

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: My amulet! Oh, you found it! Bless you, bless you! Here, take these. It isn't much, but it's all an old fishwife has to give.

journal.text: Recover Hulda's amulet from the Urchins of Black Cliff.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Hulda's amulet from the Urchins of Black Cliff.

rumour.specifics: Three villagers of Ostra: Dorrie gutting eels, Mungo the fisherman, Pell on the pier.

rumour1.speaker: Dorrie
rumour1.text: Not now! I've got a whole basket of eels to skin.

rumour2.speaker: Mungo
rumour2.text: I've seen dead men walking in the shallows! Dead men! Who's going to buy fish out of a lake full of dead men?

rumour3.speaker: Pell
rumour3.text: Mayor Odrick hasn't set foot outside his house since the dead came up. Some mayor!

shop_greeting.specifics: Mag of the Wet Herring tavern, Haldo the armourer, Zebulin the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Mag
inn.text: Sit yerself down, dearie! We got fish stew, fish pie, or fish. Heh, heh...

arms.speaker: Haldo
arms.text: Welcome to Haldo's! Swords, axes and good stout shields. How can I help you?

magic.speaker: Zebulin
magic.text: Ahh, a customer! With the dead walking about, you'll be wanting potions. Lots of potions! Zebulin has plenty.

two_givers.specifics: Master Ferrin wants the old beacon on Heron Point lit so the boats can come home; Snibbet wants his taxed barrel of cider stolen back out of the storehouse.

offer_a.speaker: Master Ferrin
offer_a.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. These are dark days for Ostra. Since the Necromancer seized the lighthouse on Gorm Isle, our boats come home blind in the fog, and the rocks have taken more than one.

There is an old beacon on Heron Point, along the shore west of here. If it were lit, our fishermen could find their way home.

Light it, and I shall see that you are well rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Snibbet
offer_b.text:
Psst! Hey! Over here, friend! You look like a fella who can keep his mouth shut.

Master Ferrin's men took a barrel of my best cider right off my boat. Taxes, he says! Ha! It's sitting in the storehouse on the long pier.

Fetch it back for me, quiet-like, and I'll give you a nice shiny sword. Deal?

outcome_a.speaker: Master Ferrin
outcome_a.text:
The beacon burns! Look there -- the boats are coming in! Ostra owes you a great debt, Wanderer. Take this shield as a token of our thanks.

Now go and see Mayor Odrick. He has need of you.

outcome_b.speaker: Snibbet
outcome_b.text: Ha, ha! My cider! You're a true pal! Here's the sword, like I promised. Don't go telling Ferrin where you got it. Heh, heh, heh...

journal_a.text: Light the old beacon on Heron Point for Master Ferrin.

journal_b.text: Take Snibbet's barrel of cider from the storehouse on the long pier.

rescue.specifics: Agna's boy Wim rowed out to the Drowned Chapel on the north shore to see the ghosts and is trapped there.

plea.speaker: Agna
plea.text:
Please, help me! My boy Wim took his little boat out to the Drowned Chapel on the north shore to look at the ghosts. That was yesterday morning, and he never came back!

Oh, that foolish, foolish boy! Please, bring him home to me!

found.speaker: Wim
found.text: Help! Over here! Please don't leave me, they'll come back!

following.speaker: Wim
following.text: Stay close! I don't want to see any more ghosts!

completion.speaker: Agna
completion.text:
Wim! Oh, my Wim! You're home!

Thank you, kind sir, thank you! You've saved my boy. Please take this. I wish it were more.

journal.text: Rescue Agna's son Wim from the Drowned Chapel.

main_opening.specifics: Pell sends the player to Mayor Odrick, an old friend of Grimwald, who orders him out to Gorm Isle after Skarn the Necromancer.

herald.speaker: Pell
herald.text: You're the one Grimwald sent? Mayor Odrick's been waiting on you for days! His house is at the end of the long pier.

opening.speaker: Mayor Odrick
opening.text:
Ah, at last! Grimwald said you would come. Welcome to Ostra, lad, though I wish it were in better times.

A Necromancer named Skarn has taken the old lighthouse on Gorm Isle. Every night he calls the drowned dead up out of Lake Vell, and every night more of them come ashore. Our fishermen dare not put out their boats. The village is starving!

You must cross the causeway to Gorm Isle and put an end to this foul sorcerer. Brannoc will open the gate on my word. Hurry! Ostra cannot hold out much longer.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Odrick
reminder.text: Why do you tarry? Every night that Necromancer raises more of our dead!

journal.text: Go to Gorm Isle and defeat Skarn the Necromancer.
